questions.question: Add the vectors $(3\hat{i} + 4\hat{j})\ \text{m}$ and $(5\hat{i} - 12\hat{j})\ \text{m}$ and express the resultant in magnitude and direction form.
questions.solution:
**Step 1 — Add the corresponding components:**
$$\vec{A} = 3\hat{i} + 4\hat{j}, \qquad \vec{B} = 5\hat{i} - 12\hat{j}$$
$$\vec{R} = \vec{A} + \vec{B} = (3 + 5)\hat{i} + (4 - 12)\hat{j} = 8\hat{i} - 8\hat{j}$$

**Step 2 — Magnitude of the resultant:**
$$R = \sqrt{R_x^2 + R_y^2} = \sqrt{8^2 + (-8)^2} = \sqrt{64 + 64} = \sqrt{128}$$
$$\boxed{R = 8\sqrt{2} \approx \mathbf{11.3\ \text{m}}}$$

**Step 3 — Direction of the resultant:**
$$\tan\theta = \frac{R_y}{R_x} = \frac{-8}{8} = -1 \;\Rightarrow\; \theta = -45^\circ$$
$$\boxed{\theta = \mathbf{-45^\circ},\ \text{i.e. } 45^\circ \text{ south of east}}$$

The resultant lies in the fourth quadrant since $R_x > 0$ and $R_y < 0$.
questions.knowledgeNote: Vector components add algebraically; magnitude is the root of the sum of squared components and direction from the tangent ratio.
